notes: *at midnight* was kept whole rather than split between חֲצוֹת and לָיְלָה; the competing reading would give *at* to the construct and *midnight* to the absolute, but neither morpheme owns a part of the one English word, and the supplied adverbial *at* is handed to the whole expression (rules 30, 33).
The source head is the governing construct חֲצוֹת (rule 23), since *midnight* writes both morphemes' lexemes and no one of them is uniquely defensible (rule 6).
